# Flipper the Ripper

> Free, open-source (MIT) Android app that saves publicly accessible videos from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X and Dailymotion to the phone's gallery. Share a link to the app and the download starts. No account, no ads, no tracking. Not on Google Play by design; distributed as one signed APK per release. Requires Android 7.0 or later on 64-bit ARM.

Everything below is also available without JavaScript: the page's HTML carries the current version and checksum, and `/` returns Markdown for `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Get the app

- [Newest APK](https://flipper-the-ripper.celox.io/download): 302 to the current GitHub release asset — always the newest version
- [Newest release as JSON](https://flipper-the-ripper.celox.io/latest.json): `version`, `published`, `notes`, and `assets[]` with `target`, `name`, `url`, `size` (bytes), `sha256`; refreshed every 15 minutes
- [All releases and notes](https://github.com/pepperonas/flipper-the-ripper/releases)

## Docs

- [Product page as Markdown](https://flipper-the-ripper.celox.io/index.md): features, install steps, verification, FAQ, with the current version and SHA-256 filled in
- [Agent skill: get Flipper the Ripper](https://flipper-the-ripper.celox.io/skills/get-flipper-the-ripper/SKILL.md): download, verify and install, step by step
- [Changelog](https://flipper-the-ripper.celox.io/changelog.md): Markdown, mirrored from GitHub every 15 minutes
- [README](https://github.com/pepperonas/flipper-the-ripper#readme): architecture, download engine, build and release process

## Install

1. Open [the download link](https://flipper-the-ripper.celox.io/download) on the phone.
2. Open the downloaded file; allow the browser to install apps when Android asks (once).
3. In any supported app tap Share and pick Flipper the Ripper. Updates install over the existing app; the app announces new releases itself.

## Verify

- APK checksum: `assets[0].sha256` in [latest.json](https://flipper-the-ripper.celox.io/latest.json), also `SHA256SUMS.txt` in each release.
- Signing certificate SHA-256, identical for every release since 1.0.0: `1fc3904fd80eb8135b25ee15fe62ec3b74545eba360298c152f712646fd910cb` — check with `apksigner verify --print-certs`.

## Features

- Platforms: YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, Dailymotion
- Share-sheet integration and clipboard detection; one-tap download
- Quality: Best, 1080p, 720p, 480p, audio only
- Queue: one download at a time, pause/resume from the last byte, drag to reorder, swipe finished entries away with undo
- Background downloads with one progress notification; files saved to Movies, named after the video title
- Instagram reels that need an account: the failed download offers a sign-in wizard (on Instagram's own page) and restarts itself once signed in
- Self-updating yt-dlp extractor
- Notification when a new version is released (checked twice a day, can be switched off)
- Languages: English, German, Spanish, Italian, French

## Scope and limits

- Only for publicly accessible content and personal, lawful use. Does not bypass DRM, paywalls or access restrictions.
- No playlists, no subtitles.
